name: Seeb
title: Patriarch in Seth's lineage
summary: Seeb (also called Sheba) is a person mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis and 1 Chronicles. He appears as part of the early family records that connect Adam's descendants to later generations. His role is primarily genealogical and serves to show the connection in God's plan of salvation through the family lines.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Genesis 1
keyEvents.description: Seeb is mentioned as part of the early genealogies in Genesis, which connect humanity from Adam to Noah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in 1 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Seeb appears in the genealogical records of 1 Chronicles as part of the lists of nations.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Table of Nations
keyEvents.description: Seeb is mentioned as a descendant in the Table of Nations in Genesis 10, which describes how the nations spread after the flood.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Abraham's descendants
keyEvents.description: Seeb is also mentioned as a descendant of Abraham through Keturah, which illustrates the branching and spread of the lineage.
